item.title: James Gunn Officially Comments on Casting the DCU's New Batman
item.description: It has been clear for a while now that Robert Pattinson won't be the DC Universe's Batman, even with The Batman Part II still slated for release in 2028. Fans will be sad to see BatPat go, especially considering DC Studios co-head James Gunn has kept quiet on when we will see his successor. Thankfully, Gunn has finally given a small but meaningful update on the casting process for the next Bruce Wayne.

item.title: Best Visions to use in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.description: There's so many to choose from that deciding on the best Visions in Final Fantasy Resonance often feels more than a little overwhelming. While every Vision has something that makes them worth using in certain circumstances, there is a set of them that excels in practically every situation. And you can find most of them early in the game, too.

item.title: Marvel, Star Trek Stars Post Heartbreaking Tributes to Patrick Stewart
item.description: Patrick Stewart's friends, colleagues, and fellow actors are paying tribute to the late thespian, who died on Wednesday at the age of 86 . In the wake of Stewart's death, heartfelt tributes have poured in across social media, including a heartbreaking remembrance from the actor's longtime collaborator, friend, and fellow knight Ian McKellen.

item.title: 'Star Trek Online' Players Hold Memorial Vigil for Patrick Stewart
item.description: Star Trek Online players held a virtual memorial to honor Patrick Stewart, who played Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: T he Next Generation and other Star Trek projects. Armadas of Galaxy-class starships assembled in the MMORPG. Some players launched fireworks from orbit, while others gathered on the ground for candlelit vigils. Stewart passed away Oct. 29 after a brief battle with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia.

item.title: The Onion Is Ready For GTA 6: ‘You're Kind of a Dummy For Thinking This Is Gonna Change Everything"
item.description: We’re less than one month away from the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 , and the world is preparing for what’s bound to be a culturally dominant moment. Sick days are being planned, economists are doom-spiraling, and people are debating whether it’s possible to digitally cheat on your significant other with Lucia. It’s safe to say that it’s going to be a circus, and everyone wants a bit of that pie. That includes The Onion.

item.title: Who Gave the Best Video Game Performance of 2026? The Stars Make Their Case
item.description: I’ve never understood why only Hollywood A-listers get to have fun waxing poetic on their work at the end of the year when many of the best performances I see all year are ones I’ve played through in games. I wanted that to change — so for the first time, I’m happy to present Polygon’s first-ever actor “roundtable,” a series riding the wave of our regular GOTY Watch coverage .

item.title: 2024’s Best Horror Game Is Officially Getting a Film Adaptation
item.description: Add Mouthwashing to the ever-growing list of games getting a TV or film adaptation. Sony has acquired the film rights to the 2024 indie psychological horror game developed by Wrong Organ and published by Critical Reflex. The news follows the huge success of Zach Cregger's Resident Evil adaptation, which Sony distributed and co-produced.

item.title: Honkai Star Rail version 4.7 livestream codes
item.description: Honkai: Star Rail just closed out its version 4.7 livestream , teasing what’s to come in the next update, which launches the evening of Nov. 11. Alongside new characters and events, Hoyoverse uses the stream to distribute codes that reward free Stellar Jade and other upgrade materials.

item.title: Alexander Skarsgård Raises the Bar for Hot Monsters in the Darkly Funny Wicker
item.description: Professional hot Viking Alexander Skarsgård is an expert at sending up or subverting his own studly image while also completely embodying it. In 2025's brilliant S&M romance Pillion , he deftly exposed the emotional weakness of a strapping, leather-clad biker dom. In Wicker , he achieves something similar but more tender, which is all the more remarkable for being summoned from somewhere within a truly amazing assemblage of practical and digital creature effects.

item.title: Where to use the gun store weapons locker key in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: The gun store weapons locker key is one of the more common keys in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's DMZ mode, as it isn't tied to any specific quest, and it can be used in two different locations. The description of the key states that it "unlocks the weapons lockers in gun stores, found in Western Cheongun Village and Northern Songdo Wharf," but those are still fairly large areas with lots of buildings.
